steps.content: There is a brief, awkward pause. The girl twirls a strand of her hair, looking here and there.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: But... we've still got to eat dinner, right? We will think about the problems after the meal, okay?
The girl invites Ignis over to the kitchen, saying she is free to use it in any way she wants.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: No, you don't understand. I'm really terrible at cooking... I just can't do it...

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: But... you did take a good look at my kitchenware as soon as you came in, didn't you?
The girl gives a small smile, approaches Ignis, and gently grasps her hand.
Ignis isn't used to such contact and tries to withdraw her hand, but the girl grips it firmly.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Don't be scared, here... you can be whoever you want to be, just follow your heart!

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: It's fine if you don't cook well; it doesn't even matter if you don't know how to cook. As long as you make the choice, "They" will handle everything...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: They... Will they really... be able... to help me cook?
Ignis locks eyes with the girl, seeing in them a vision of someone gently holding her face, murmuring something close to her ear.
Slowly, a shadow creeps into Ignis's eyes, stealing away their light.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I... I just want to be able to cook with fire... and have nothing go wrong...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I long... to cook, to live a life... just like anyone else...

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: That's right! Just figure out who you want to be in this place, and you can become that person!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Really... Can it really be like that?
The girl picks an apple and extends it towards Ignis.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: How about trying it out?
With the apple in hand, Ignis moves to the chopping board and grabs a paring knife.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I... I just want to cook with fire normally, to lead a regular life...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I... I want to be someone like that... I desire to... bake an apple pie... for Chief...
Delicately dicing the apples, Ignis tiptoes to the stove with great care.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Trust in yourself, trust that you've already become who you're meant to be!
Pop.
The stove's blue flame suddenly leaps up, just right in size, neatly covering the base of the frying pan.
It didn't swell in size, nor did it set the whole kitchen ablaze.
Gradually, bit by bit, in Ignis's gaze, the modest flame of the stove is mirrored.
